processing: Transparent snapshots composited on opaque backdrop. Fixed integer head crops enlarged 2x nearest-neighbor. Whole model reduced to 480px with Lanczos. No sharpening or AI postprocessing.
normalPolicy: B has no source NORMAL; the official viewer computes normals. C/C2 source vertex NORMAL is retained. No normals are added during clay preparation. Positions, indices, transforms and GLB binary chunks remain unchanged. Official converter obtains trimesh.vertex_normals when source normals are absent and sends them to the mesh renderer. Color and tangent normal textures removed in separate diagnostic GLBs.
limitation: This compares actual mesh appearance, including each stage shading normals. It is not ground-truth geometry accuracy or a Box render; consult the separate same-RGB Box controls.
